name: rag-architect
description: Design and audit Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines — chunking strategy, embedding choice, hybrid search, retrieval evaluation, and failure diagnosis. Use when asked to "build a RAG system", "fix retrieval quality", "improve RAG accuracy", "chunk documents", "add semantic search", or when an LLM keeps hallucinating despite having access to docs. Do NOT use for: fine-tuning decisions — that is a separate trade-off.
